facts.text: Marist offers the First-Year Florence Experience, allowing incoming students to spend their first year of college studying in Florence, Italy.

sources.title: First-Year Florence Experience | Marist Italy - Marist University
sources.quote: Begin your college experience in Florence, Italy where culture and creativity shape daily life and immerse yourself in Italian art, language, cuisine, and community. Stay on track with your Marist degree pursuing foundational coursework
